summary: The LLM landscape in late 2026 is dominated by a handful of frontier families from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google, with cost-efficient open-weight challengers from DeepSeek, Meta, Mistral, and Alibaba gaining significant enterprise traction. Real-world adoption is increasingly shaped by cloud aggregator reach (AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, Snowflake Cortex, IBM watsonx), which gives models available on multiple secure enterprise platforms outsized consumption numbers. Because the live research data contains several speculative or unverified version numbers, this ranking is restricted to models that are confirmed publicly available today and conservatively named.

models.name: GPT-4o
models.popularity_notes: Remains the most widely called general-purpose model via direct API and Azure OpenAI Service, giving it the broadest enterprise aggregator reach of any model.
models.best_for: General-purpose production applications and multimodal chat

models.name: Claude Sonnet 4.6
models.popularity_notes: Research notes it matches Opus-level performance at Sonnet pricing, driving heavy developer coding adoption and broad availability across AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, and Snowflake Cortex.
models.best_for: Agentic coding and enterprise software development

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Pro
models.popularity_notes: Dubbed the 'context window king' in the research, it benefits from deep Google Vertex AI integration and large context handling popular with enterprises.
strengths: Native Vertex AI / Google Cloud integration
models.best_for: Long-document analysis and large-context enterprise workloads

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Flash
models.popularity_notes: High-volume, low-cost model with a large context window, widely adopted for cost-sensitive workloads through Vertex AI and Google AI Studio.

models.name: DeepSeek R1
models.popularity_notes: The cheapest frontier-class reasoning model per the research ($0.55/$2.19), with huge HuggingFace download numbers and growing aggregator availability.

models.name: DeepSeek V3
models.popularity_notes: Widely downloaded open-weight general model offering near-frontier performance at a fraction of proprietary cost, popular for self-hosted deployments.

models.name: Llama 3.3 70B
models.popularity_notes: One of the most downloaded open-weight models on HuggingFace and available across AWS Bedrock, Azure, and Vertex AI, giving it broad enterprise self-hosting reach.

models.name: o3
models.popularity_notes: OpenAI's dedicated reasoning model widely used for complex coding and STEM tasks, available via direct API and Azure OpenAI Service.
strengths: Strong on complex coding and math
models.best_for: Complex reasoning, STEM, and difficult coding problems

models.name: Claude Haiku 4.5
models.popularity_notes: Fast, low-cost member of the Claude family popular for high-volume tasks and available through AWS Bedrock and Google Vertex AI.

models.name: Mistral Large 2
models.popularity_notes: Leading European frontier model with strong adoption via Azure AI and AWS Bedrock, favored for its open-weight availability and multilingual strength.

models.name: Qwen3-235B-A22B
models.popularity_notes: Top-performing open-weight MoE model with rapidly growing HuggingFace downloads and strong adoption in Asia and among self-hosters.
models.best_for: Cost-efficient open-source reasoning and multilingual tasks
